name: Pardon
overview: Scripture reveals that pardon is a gracious act of God, who forgives iniquity, transgression, and sin while maintaining justice (Exodus 34:7). The atonement through the blood, given by God, is the means by which souls are made clean and pardoned (Leviticus 17:11). Biblical examples such as David’s confession and pardon show that God puts away sin upon repentance (2 Samuel 12:13), and He promises to forgive and heal when His people humble themselves and seek Him in prayer (2 Chronicles 7:14; 30:18). God’s pardon is thus both a compassionate and faithful response to repentance and intercession.
